newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK land auction - Eton Properties buys both sites.
newsitem.headline: HK land auction - Eton Properties buys both sites.

text.p: Eton Properties Development Co Ltd bought both the Repulse Bay and Tuen Mun sites in Wednesday's Hong Kong government land auction, government land agent Francis Ng said.
The 2,008-square-metre Repulse Bay site on the south side of Hong Kong island slated for luxury residential purposes sold for HK$230 million against expectations of HK$179-188 million.
The 5,080-square-metre Tuen Mun site in the New Territories slated for mass residential usage sold for HK$258 million against expectations of HK$178-200 million.
